notes: Orchestration and kanban - car 2 of the autonomous-operations design: a goal now decomposes into milestones, runs across parallel delegates, degrades gracefully instead of stalling, and shows its full shape on a board. Planning: the MILESTONE marker groups the plan slice into a structured milestone/subtask tree (method-exhaustion list and blockers tracked alongside; plans without milestones fall into a single bucket, car-1 missions stay compatible). Parallelism: mission slices keep the full toolset including delegate - one slice can fan out to three isolated sub-agents, with delegate counts recorded in the event stream. Degraded entry: running to degraded on a gap in the current subtask, other queued subtasks keep advancing (single-point failure never stalls the mission), back to running on the next subtask or unblock, pause allowed from degraded, resume keeps gaps. Budgets are configurable: mission.max_slices / max_wall_hours / max_daily_model_calls settings (bounds-validated, defaults 40 / 24 / 200) and an optional per-start budget object frozen into the mission record - later settings changes never touch a running mission; tripwire sealing with evidence is unchanged. Board: GET /api/mission?id= returns the detail projection - plan tree, scrubbed event tail (last 20), frozen budget vs usage - with the list shape untouched for existing clients. Console: the MISSIONS card grows a clickable detail pane (milestone progress with per-subtask state glyphs, method marking ratio, last-report age, budget utilization with 80 percent warning, event tail) plus optional budget inputs on start, and a new read-only ORCHESTRATION card summarizes tools / channels / web3 / credential slots / skills with deep links into the existing controls - no second switchboard; 32 new mission.* and orch.* keys (packs 562 to 594). Verification: new tmp/e2e_mission_orch.py leg 63/63 covers the four states - decomposition into milestones, two real delegate fan-outs in one slice, degraded entry with sibling subtasks still advancing, and sealing via both the budget tripwire and an explicit stop - plus the detail shape, frozen-budget assertion, 404 honesty, sentinel zero-leak and production byte identity.
